description: Search finished Polish public tenders (submission deadline passed) — e.g. similar past tenders to price an offer, and who won them. A tender matches when it contains every word of the query (title, contracting authority, CPV, description); recently finished tenders close in meaning are added. Each card's `teaser` starts with the award result as the tender's public page shows it: 'Wynik: wygrała <company> — <amount> zł; ofert: <offers>; <date>.', several winners by part, 'Wynik: unieważniony.' (cancelled) or 'Wynik: brak w danych.' (no result known yet — common for tenders finished in the last months); an amount only where it is reliable. only_settled=true lists only tenders with a known winner — use it to compare prices. Optional filters: CPV codes with all their sub-codes (cpv_codes, from cpv_search), voivodeships, works / supplies / services, estimated value, submission-deadline and publication-date ranges; sort by relevance, deadline or publication date. get_tender_results gives the full results (`winners` by part, offer price band). Few results: try fewer or other Polish words; `hint` says how to search again when nothing matches. Tenders without an AI summary are included (has_summary=false). `mode` is 'semantic' when the meaning search took part, 'lexical' otherwise; `unapplied_filters` lists filters a temporary fallback could not apply. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

cpv.description: Restrict to tenders whose CPV includes this code, with or without the check digit: '79952000' or '79952000-2'

cpv_codes.description: CPV codes from cpv_search, each with all its sub-codes ('79952000' also finds 79952100); a tender matches any of them

deadline_after.description: ISO date; only tenders with submission deadline after it

deadline_before.description: ISO date; only tenders with submission deadline before it

only_settled.description: Only tenders with a known winner — to compare prices. About half of the tenders finished 3–24 months ago have one, fewer of those finished in the last 3 months

published_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD; published on or after that day

published_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD; published on or before that day

query.description: Words to find, in Polish — the tenders are in Polish, e.g. 'spotkanie mikołajkowe dla dzieci'

region.description: Voivodeship (województwo): slug or name from list_facets, e.g. 'slaskie' or 'śląskie'

regions.description: Voivodeships (slug or name from list_facets); a tender matches any of them
